mission: Desh stares at the Corridor map with the amplification overlay. His expression goes clinical. 'I know what she built. I know how to break it.' Three critical nodes, a solo sabotage against Veraine's small crew guards, an amplification threshold that collapses under the failure of three carefully chosen antennas. Before anyone can ask, he volunteers.
why_now: The group's plan cannot succeed as a Force-only operation. The amplification array has to drop below threshold, and Desh is the only person in the camp who can do it. His arc and the plan's mechanics converge in the same scene.
conflict: Desh has been the operator, not the volunteer. The sabotage is solo, against armed opposition, and the three critical nodes are already Veraine's. Ben was prepared to ask. Desh gets there first.
turning_point: Desh volunteers before anyone asks. 'That's my job. Let the Force-users do the Force thing. I'll handle the part that requires hands.' The arc's new-truth beat as a single line.
opening_hook: Desh stares at the Corridor map with the amplification overlay and his expression goes very still. 'I know what she built. I know how to break it.'
closing_hook: Two plans, both dependent on trust: the resonance trio needs Kael; the sabotage needs Desh alone against armed opposition. Both plans fail without both parts.
emotional_trajectory: Tactical revelation -> Desh's willing commitment -> the interlocking dependency

stakes.personal: Desh's arc lands — the choice unmistakable
stakes.interpersonal: The group becoming a genuine team through voluntary specialisation
stakes.external: The two-pronged plan is the only path to defeating Veraine and saving the seal

setting: Veranthos — camp, tactical planning with Corridor data
sensory_details: The amplification array visible on the map — a web of repurposed nodes pointing at Veranthos; Desh's analyst calm overlaid with a personal steadiness that is new; dawn approaching, the window for the run narrowing
action_beats: Desh stares at the Corridor map with the amplification overlay and his expression goes clinical — intelligence analyst, not friend
Desh traces the three critical nodes on the map and outlines his solo sabotage approach
Desh volunteers before anyone asks — straightening from the map table with his decision already made
notes: Desh's arc new-truth beat — volunteers unasked. The former GAG operative choosing the dangerous task. Do not have Ben or Sera articulate the arc on-page; Desh's straightening from the map and his line about hands deliver the work. Voice: Zahn-procedural with one permitted Allston-quiet beat on Desh's volunteer line. Anti-pattern: no speech from Desh about why; the decision is structural, his line is short.
